'''Overload dispersal tubes''' were components used in [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] such as the [[w-165 planetary turbolaser]]. The emplacement employed over four dozen overload dispersal tubes that were designed to absorb excess energy generated by the weapon and ensured that explosions were prevented.<ref name="EGWT" />
